titel: Men's Staple Ringer Tee | AS Colour 5053
description:
Give your everyday t-shirt lineup a retro edge with this classic ringer tee. Contrasting details at the neck and sleeves add definition, while the midweight combed cotton and regular fit keep it comfortable and easy to style.

· 100% combed cotton
· Fabric weight: 5.3 oz./yd.² (180 g/m²)
· 26 singles
· Regular fit
· Contrasting ribbing at the neck and sleeve hems
· Side-seamed construction
· Shoulder-to-shoulder taping
· Double-needle hems
· Preshrunk to minimize shrinkage
· Blank product sourced from Bangladesh
